description: Prepare, run, monitor, and retrieve Helio Dragon thermal workflows. Companion slicing and G-code timing use Helio slicer-cli. Slicer source code, licences and acknowledgements: https://github.com/Helio-Additive/slicer-cli/blob/main/docs/open-source.md

interface.longDescription: Assess the thermal behaviour of an existing G-code file or enhance it for a supported printer and material. Review the plan, start a run when ready, track progress, and retrieve available results. Companion slicing and G-code timing use Helio slicer-cli with Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and Snapmaker Orca engines. Slicer source code, licences and acknowledgements: https://github.com/Helio-Additive/slicer-cli/blob/main/docs/open-source.md

name: helioadditive-dragon
